text: Built a Rust vector search index that compresses embeddings to 2 bits per dimension using Google's TurboQuant algorithm, achieving 12.6x compression with no training or calibration step
Implemented a NEON SIMD-accelerated, multi-threaded (rayon) search kernel exposed to Python via PyO3 and maturin
Validated the quantization algorithm in a Python and NumPy prototype before porting to Rust, improving per-query latency from 45.1ms to 0.461ms
